name: Cantorate Hull Blueprints
desc: The Cantorate's hull scores: growth and calibration protocols for the lattice cores of its line ships, with the frames written around them. Enables heavy industry to construct Lattice hulls.

name: Cantorate Weapon Blueprints
desc: Rail, lance and spike patterns tuned to lattice cores. Enables heavy industry to construct the Cantorate's weapons.

name: Cantorate Wing Blueprints
desc: Fighter LPCs for the Cantorate's tuned wings. Enables heavy industry to construct Lattice fighters.

name: Pulsar Metronome
desc: A navigation clock grown around a sliver of lattice crystal and keyed to the beat of a pulsar. Installed in a Waystation it times every approach, docking and departure to a pitch no jammer can touch; traffic flows, and nobody waits in the dark.

name: Lacrimosa's Sash and Vanes
desc: The Lacrimosa's sash and vanes, taken from the flagship of the Hush: a ribbon of lattice crystal grown to run down a Virtuoso's spine, and the two great vanes that steer its voice. Still humming. Only the dock of the Antiphon Institute can mount them.
